comments.body:
RP-01 S2 — design grounding evidence (moved here to keep the description within the plan-review admission limit; see the Approach/Scope in the description).

## `ceil(x/2)` request-budget census (full sweep of build_usage_limits)
- `completion_banking.iteration_limit_for(B)` (line 279) returns `2*B` — the exact inverse of the base `req_limit = ceil(eff_max_iter/2)` that `build_usage_limits` RETURNS.
- `completion_banking.plan_recovery_pool` (line 243) independently applies `ceil(floor/2)` to the verify-step floor — same `ceil(x/2)` SHAPE on a different input, so it must not be conflated with the request-budget formula.
- `usage_log.py` / `runner.py` only RECEIVE the built `UsageLimits.request_limit` as an argument; they are NOT formula consumers.
- Invariant preserved: `build_usage_limits` keeps RETURNING the bare base `req_limit` (telemetry + banking inverse), and the output-retry allowance is an addend ONLY inside the constructed `UsageLimits.request_limit`. The source-census test pins BOTH encodings: returned `req_limit == ceil(eff_max_iter/2)` AND `UsageLimits.request_limit == base + allowance`.
- Impacted existing seam tests (both pin the CONSTRUCTED request_limit, so both move base→base+allowance): `test_settings_builders_seam.py:80` and `test_llm_failure_matrix.py::test_runner_computes_derived_usage_limits:341`.

## pydantic-ai shared-counter mechanism (verified in source + empirically, pydantic-ai 1.107.2)
- A single per-run counter `_agent_graph.GraphAgentState.output_retries_used` (line 127) is incremented by `consume_output_retry(max_output_retries)` (line 162), which raises `UnexpectedModelBehavior("Exceeded maximum output retries (N)")` when exceeded (lines 176-178).
- BOTH a capability-hook `ModelRetry` (via `_build_retry_node`, line 1036) AND a `TextOutput`-validator `ModelRetry` decrement this SAME counter, bounded by `retries={"output": N}`.
- Spike proof: error-retry (guard) + invalid-json-retry (output fn) with R=1 exhausts after 2 calls; R=2 succeeds after 3 calls. The plan pins this BEHAVIORALLY (success at exactly N, abort at N-1) via the limit-matrix oracle rather than citing private internals (the reviewer sandbox cannot verify private symbols).

## Wire-projection fit rule grounding (public fields only)
- Each `ModelResponse` carries a public `.usage` (`RequestUsage` with `input_tokens`/`output_tokens`) — VERIFIED public field.
- `model_classes.own_window_tokens(model)` (model_classes.py:69) is the established single source of model context-window knowledge (substring match against `MODEL_WINDOW_LADDER`; unknown -> ladder minimum, conservative per bug 48b3). This is the "window" the fit rule references — it EXISTS.
- Fit rule uses only public fields + this existing helper — no private internals.

## structured.py classification authority (must NOT be mutated)
- `_UNRETRYABLE_STOP_REASONS = frozenset({refusal, max_tokens, length, content_filter})` (line 632).
- `check_stop_reason(stop_reason)` (line 635) inspects ONLY the normalized finish_reason and RAISES (truncation/refusal -> `UnretryableOutputError`; `error` -> retryable `StructuredOutputError`).
- `check_response(response)` (line 651) does TWO layers: finish_reason via check_stop_reason PLUS the raw `provider_details['finish_reason']`/`'refusal'` key (the #5221 defense). Neither RETURNS a reason — both only RAISE, which is why the S2 guard does its own read-only two-layer read for the truncation subset before delegating.
- `OUTPUT_RETRIES = 2` is the default allowance N.

## Context / Problem
`_pai_structured` creates fresh Agent runs for prompted-output recovery, so output attempts can reset the request budget and history is assembled outside Pydantic (`structured_run.py:87-178`). The RP-01 contract instead composes the S1 output-policy adapter [rebar:grazeable-preferred-bumblebee] (landed: `src/rebar/llm/pai_output.py`; review `--ref HEAD`) in one Agent operation, preserving every authoritative input and stored response.

## Approach
Replace the manual attempt scheduler with one Pydantic `Agent` run composing the S1 adapter (`pai_output.output_function` as `output_type=TextOutput(fn)`) with two new seams from `src/rebar/llm/pai_retry.py`:

1. **Wire-context projection — a pydantic-ai `history_processors` `HistoryProcessor`.** The Agent-level `history_processors=[proc]` seam runs a callable before each request returning a wire COPY without mutating stored state, so `result.all_messages()` keeps full history regardless of wire omissions. It puts a failed `ModelResponse` on the retry wire ONLY when, for every viable candidate, that response's own `response.usage.input_tokens + output_tokens` (the tokens it already billed) plus `effective_max_tokens` fits `model_classes.own_window_tokens(candidate)`; else it omits that response WHOLE (never partially; missing/zero usage → omit). Authoritative input alone over the window (`input_tokens + effective_max_tokens > window`, nothing added) fails closed with the new typed `ContextWindowExceededError` — never shortened.

2. **Truncation reclassification — a concision-aware operation guard.** Guard attachment is PER OUTPUT MODE. On the PROMPTED branch ONLY (`output_type=TextOutput(fn)`), `pai_retry` supplies its own `after_model_request` capability in place of `pai_output.guard_capability()`; the NativeOutput branch keeps `pai_output.guard_capability()` unchanged (terminal). `guard_capability`'s contract for other callers is likewise UNCHANGED until S5 cutover. Because the shared classifiers only RAISE (never return a reason), the guard does a read-only two-layer read for the truncation subset ONLY — `finish_reason` OR raw `provider_details['finish_reason']` in {`length`,`max_tokens`} (two layers, mirroring check_response, so a provider_details-only truncation #5221 is caught): (a) on a truncation signal it raises, before parsing, `pydantic_ai.ModelRetry("Make your response as concise as possible while fulfilling the prompt and output format requirements.")` — bounded, in-run; (b) else it delegates to the SAME S1 logic — `check_response`: re-raise terminal `UnretryableOutputError` (refusal/`content_filter`), translate retryable `StructuredOutputError` (`error`) into `ModelRetry`. The shared `structured.py` tables are NOT modified (read, never mutated).

3. **One shared request budget, one shared retry counter.** `build_usage_limits` sets the operation-wide `UsageLimits.request_limit` = base allowance (`ceil(eff_max_iter/2)`) PLUS the configured output-retry allowance, computed once, NO per-attempt reset. The RETURNED `req_limit` (telemetry + `completion_banking.iteration_limit_for`) stays the BARE base, so the `2×B` inverse stays exact; the allowance is an addend only inside the constructed `UsageLimits`. The allowance N (`structured.OUTPUT_RETRIES`=2, lowered by `req.structured_retry_limit`) seeds BOTH `retries={"output": N}` AND the `request_limit` addend from ONE value, so the request budget can NEVER trip before the output-retry counter. That the concision `ModelRetry` (capability hook) and the parse/validation `ModelRetry` (`TextOutput` fn) share ONE counter is pinned BEHAVIORALLY by the limit-matrix oracle (pass at N, abort at N−1), not any private symbol. On exhaustion pydantic-ai raises `UnexpectedModelBehavior` ("Exceeded maximum output retries"), translated to a rebar-typed `UnretryableOutputError`.

**NativeOutput preserved.** `structured.output_mode`'s NativeOutput (constrained-decoding) selection and its documented bug-895c grammar-compilation fallback to the prompted path are kept UNCHANGED: the NativeOutput branch runs as the same bounded operation (`output_type=NativeOutput`), sharing the wire projection and the one output-retry counter, but attaching `pai_output.guard_capability()` — NOT the concision guard. Concision applies ONLY to the prompted branch — a fixed decoding grammar (not verbosity) drives a native turn's size, so a truncated native turn stays TERMINAL via `guard_capability`/`check_response`. Only the manual for-loop is replaced — not mode selection, the 895c fallback, or native terminal truncation.

## Scope
- `src/rebar/llm/pai_retry.py` — new: (a) the `HistoryProcessor` wire projection (fit decision + non-mutating whole-response include/omit) and (b) the concision-aware guard (see Approach §2). Docstring records the combined-allowance derivation. No provider selection, usage projection, or persistence.
- `src/rebar/llm/structured_run.py` — replace the manual `_pai_structured` attempt scheduling with one Agent operation; extend `build_usage_limits` to derive the combined `request_limit` (base + output allowance) with no counter reset (this is where `req_limit` is computed, not `agent_call.py`).
- `src/rebar/llm/agent_call.py` — thread the two seams and `retries={"output": allowance}` into `build_agent_kwargs` (wiring only; does not compute the allowance).
- `src/rebar/llm/errors.py` — add `ContextWindowExceededError(LLMRunnerError)` for authoritative-input overflow.
- `src/rebar/llm/runner.py` — compose the helper without exceeding the 800-line cap.
- `tests/unit/test_structured_run.py`, `test_runner_pydantic_budget.py`, `test_pydantic_ai_runner.py`, plus the two seams pinning the CONSTRUCTED `request_limit` — `test_settings_builders_seam.py` and `test_llm_failure_matrix.py::test_runner_computes_derived_usage_limits` (both move `ceil(mi/2)`→base+allowance) — operation/history/limit contracts.

**Consumers of the `ceil(x/2)` budget shape** (sweep of `build_usage_limits`): `completion_banking.iteration_limit_for` (`2×B`) and `plan_recovery_pool` (`ceil(floor/2)`) both stay exact because `build_usage_limits` keeps RETURNING the bare base `req_limit`; the allowance lives only inside the constructed `UsageLimits`. A source-census test pins both encodings as authoritative (full sweep + pydantic-ai grounding in ticket comment).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Invalid-then-valid output completes in one Agent run reporting exactly two requests under one shared `UsageLimits`; verified by real-`FunctionModel` tests.
- [ ] A complete 5,000-char failed response is on the retry wire only when the full request plus output reserve provably fits (`input_tokens + effective_max_tokens <= window` for every candidate); verified by a fit test.
- [ ] When it does not fit — or the count is unknown — zero chars of it reach the wire while `all_messages()` retains all 5,000; verified by omit + unknown-count tests.
- [ ] Authoritative-input overflow raises `ContextWindowExceededError` with no shortening of system/user/tool content; verified by an oversize-input test.
- [ ] `length`/`max_tokens` consumes at most the shared output-retry allowance and sends exactly the concision instruction from Approach §2; verified by success + exhaustion cases.
- [ ] Refusal/content-filter stays terminal after one model call, triggering neither output retry nor fallback (an in-run `ModelRetry` never reaches `fallback_on`); verified by call- and candidate-count assertions.
- [ ] The NativeOutput branch still selects via `output_mode`, runs under the shared bounded operation with `pai_output.guard_capability()` attached (NOT the concision guard), keeps truncation TERMINAL (no concision retry), and preserves the bug-895c grammar-compilation fallback to the prompted path; verified by native-run and 895c-fallback tests.
- [ ] The combined allowance is documented in the `pai_retry.py` docstring, and no per-attempt reset path remains; verified by that docstring plus a source-census and budget test.
